notes.title: LavaLoop Playtest V0.3.2.2 🏆 FLIP JURY AWARD
notes.content: [p]Update following the FLIP! I had the honor of receiving the JURY AWARD. I'm so happy! I received a lot of feedback over the three days of game presentations, and the jury gave me constructive comments that will help me make major choices for future updates. Here is a first series of changes that don't add any content but improve the gaming experience:[/p][p]Improvements and gameplay comfort:[/p][p]•	Better synchronization and more flexibility in rhythm mechanics[/p][p]•	Super attack every 8 beats: The player can move while pressing \[JUMP] to validate the super attack (several players move continuously and were unable to launch the 5-beam special attack).[/p][p]•	Once injured, if the player can't get up in time after three hits, it get up automatically.[/p][p]•	The color gauge no longer decreases if you stay still.[/p][p]•	Pressing A during transitions between levels increases the color gauge.[/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p]•	The player often fall through platforms while falling. This has been fixed![/p][p]•	The "press A" prompt every 8 beats wasn't displayed when in the air. This has been fixed![/p][p]•	The 2 Giant Circular Saw levels: Improved timing and level flow.[/p][p]•	Ladybug Mini-boss: Fixed the last phase where some spike balls would randomly launch.[/p][p]•	Chains no longer target enemies which can only be destroyed with the super beam.[/p][p]•	The music would sometimes cut out when returning to the main menu.[/p][p]Visual Effects:[/p][p]•	Platforms dance and flash, like in "Crypt of the Necrodancer" 😊[/p][p]•	Jolting effect when landing on platforms[/p][p]•	Jumping between levels no longer displays a lag on levels with giant circular saws.[/p][p]•	Various improvements (smoke effect at the base of musical beams, more colorful platforms in the level with rings)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646774/b3e9b6e7621b1ca82b00d47dac47628f8d3092f7.jpg"][/img][/p]
